title: ActionReceipt
description: Terminal success receipt for an applied mutation, returned by game.act and re-readable via game.action_result (plan §5.1). Committed event IDs let the client correlate with observations.

actionId.description: Echo of the request envelope's actionId.

status.description: Terminal success. Non-terminal/failed outcomes use error-envelope or result-status pending/rejected.

revision.description: New committed state revision after this mutation.

result.description: Sanitized command-specific outcome. Only information the acting civ is permitted to know post-action (a legal move may reveal tiles or change ownership).

pendingDecisions.description: Recomputed decision queue after this mutation. Listing is not reservation; options are revalidated before application.

committedEventIds.description: Authoritative engine event IDs committed with this action (action_committed et al.).
